title: DistriQueue: High-Performance Distributed Serverless Task Broker
tagline: An event-driven distributed task execution broker with custom consensus mechanisms, sliding-window rate limiting, and failure retry backoffs.

problemStatement.overview: Traditional task queues rely heavily on databases that form operational bottlenecks. DistriQueue scales horizontally by deploying worker nodes that coordinate tasks over gRPC, balancing loads dynamically without centralized failure points.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Infrastructure engineering teams, high-traffic SaaS operators
userPersonas: SaaS system administrator looking for lightweight queue setups.
DevOps lead seeking to limit container overhead.

systemArchitecture.narrative: Nodes form a peer cluster using a lightweight custom gossip protocol. Tasks are partitioned using consistent hashing across available node instances.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Client Task Submission -> Hash Ring Router -> Assign Node -> Write to Local Redis Cache -> Background Worker Execution.

advanced: Custom Gossip Protocol for cluster discovery.

tables.name: workers
tables.description: Stores live heartbeats of node clusters.

directoryStructure:
distrique/
├── broker/
│   ├── main.go
│   ├── ring/             # Hash ring implementation
│   └── worker/           # Background execution loops
└── Cargo.toml

resumeBullets: Architected a zero-dependency distributed task scheduler in Go using consistent hashing, lowering message dispatch latencies by 35%.

interviewQuestions.question: What happens if a node drops offline mid-execution?
interviewQuestions.answerHint: Explain how heartbeat thresholds trigger ring rebalancing, routing unacknowledged tasks to backup worker instances.

title: RaftVault: Highly Available Distributed Secret Key-Value Store
tagline: Implements Raft consensus protocol from scratch to replicate encrypted secrets across multi-datacenter nodes safely.

problemStatement.overview: Secrets databases form soft target security vaults. RaftVault encrypts properties at rest, replicating states over a Raft cluster nodes pool.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Cloud Security Teams, infrastructure administrators, financial software companies
userPersonas: Security officer protecting database connection credentials

systemArchitecture.narrative: Elects raft leader. Commits log entries dynamically. Syncs replication states securely to follower node databases.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Client write -> Raft Leader -> Append Entries to Followers -> Quorum Consensus -> Commit Secret to local BoltDB.

resumeBullets: Developed custom Raft replication secret store database handling quorum failure rollbacks in Go.

title: DistriCache: Fault-Tolerant Memory Caching Cluster
tagline: Consistent-hashing partitioned caching cluster with peer replication and LRU memory eviction rules.

problemStatement.overview: Single cache nodes form system failure risk caps. DistriCache partitions cache segments, auto-replicating node contents to adjacent peers.
problemStatement.targetAudience: High performance web teams, gaming backend engineers
userPersonas: SaaS infrastructure engineer mapping DB scaling solutions

systemArchitecture.narrative: Rust cluster nodes communicate using gRPC. Injects partitioned writes across hash coordinates. Evicts keys using LRU policies.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Write cache key -> Consistent hashing lookup -> Target node write -> Async peer replicate write -> Success check.

resumeBullets: Engineered distributed partition cache system in Rust lower read latency by 45%.

title: StreamNode: Event Log Streaming Broker
tagline: Lightweight pub-sub messaging streaming broker executing disk-backed log appending structures.

problemStatement.overview: Event message queues are highly resource heavy. StreamNode writes logs sequentially to disk files, matching topic offsets in seconds.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Microservices developers, IoT sensor log gatherers, data pipelines leads
userPersonas: IoT data engineer tracing high frequency sensors logs

systemArchitecture.narrative: Receives payloads via custom TCP protocol. Appends sequential messages to segment logs. Tracks consumers cursor indices.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Producer TCP push -> StreamNode segment appender -> Index update -> Consumer TCP pull request -> Read disk bytes.

resumeBullets: Built high-performance custom pub-sub streaming log broker handling 100k+ TPS on Go.

title: GraphCore: Distributed Graph Database Processing Engine
tagline: Scalable graph query execution engine running relational BFS and PageRank queries across multiple partition nodes.

problemStatement.overview: Evaluating graph page ranks is extremely compute heavy on single server limits. GraphCore partitions vertices across cluster actor nodes.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Network analysts, search database developers, AI knowledge graph architects
userPersonas: Search analyst evaluating page rankings paths

systemArchitecture.narrative: Akka actors run nodes. Distributes computation messages dynamically. Consolidates calculations at coordinator node.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Upload Graph data -> Hash Partition vertices -> Akka Actor nodes -> PageRank compute cycles -> Akka Message exchange -> consolidate results.

resumeBullets: Developed distributed graph PageRank query compiler utilizing Scala and Akka Actor systems.

title: MeshLock: Distributed Coordinator and Mutual Exclusion Lock
tagline: Implements lease locking consensus and lock discovery nodes over custom UDP gossip protocols.

problemStatement.overview: Microservice schedulers execute double triggers if lock managers crash. MeshLock uses dynamic voting algorithms to ensure unique locks.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Distributed systems developers, database transaction planners
userPersonas: FinTech architect ensuring unique payment triggers

systemArchitecture.narrative: UDP gossip maintains cluster nodes state. gRPC locks requests require majority approval voting to lease.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Lock request -> gRPC leader -> Vote requests to peers -> Quorum success -> Lease saved to LevelDB.

advanced: Dynamic node network split split-brain analyzer

resumeBullets: Created distributed UDP consensus lease locks coordinator with automatic split-brain resolution.

title: ProxyDNS: Distributed Load-Balancing DNS Server
tagline: Dynamic DNS server routing users queries based on geo-location and local system latency metrics.

problemStatement.overview: Static DNS setups route queries to dead nodes. ProxyDNS pings servers dynamically, mapping requests to the fastest healthy target.
problemStatement.targetAudience: CDN developers, network operations, cloud administrators
userPersonas: SRE engineer mapping traffic CDNs routes

systemArchitecture.narrative: A DNS server listening on port 53. Resolves queries locally, comparing target backend health data to SQLite routes configurations.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: DNS Query -> DNS Protocol parser -> geolocation check -> latency db query -> optimal target ip output.

resumeBullets: Developed GeoIP DNS balancing server in Rust utilizing Tokio, routing 10k+ requests dynamically.

title: LedgerSync: Proof-of-Authority Distributed blockchain ledger
tagline: A lightweight private ledger implementing Proof-of-Authority transaction block replication.

problemStatement.overview: Supply chain partners require unique ledger blocks verify logs without heavy mining hardware requirements.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Enterprise supply chain administrators, private networks users
userPersonas: Logistics auditor verifying cargo storage parameters

systemArchitecture.narrative: Authorized signing nodes compile blocks. Follower nodes audit cryptographical signatures, adding blocks to database.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Transaction submit -> Signer node validates -> Cryptographical block signature -> Block distribute -> SQLite commit.

resumeBullets: Engineered private Proof-of-Authority ledger in Python handling block encryption and signature checks.

title: NetMonitor: Distributed Network health and packet analyser
tagline: Renders real-time graphs auditing latency, TCP retransmissions, and network drops across worker nodes.

problemStatement.overview: Detecting micro-outages in cluster networks requires packet monitors running non-invasively at connection coordinates.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Network Engineers, SRE teams, operations leaders

systemArchitecture.narrative: Worker agents capture raw network packets. Compiles statistics metrics and sends entries to centralized InfluxDB store.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Raw PCAP capture -> Packet parser agent -> Aggregated metrics -> InfluxDB write -> Dashboard visual panels.

resumeBullets: Built distributed network socket packet analyzer capturing TCP latency metrics in InfluxDB.

title: TaskSync: Distributed Multi-User Collaboration Sync Engine
tagline: Implements CRDT (Conflict-Free Replicated Data Types) structures to synchronize database states dynamically across disconnected clients.

problemStatement.overview: Collaborative drawing and text apps encounter server merge lockups. TaskSync uses CRDT vectors to merge changes client-side safely.
problemStatement.targetAudience: Collaborative tools creators, offline-first applications developers
userPersonas: Web developer building an offline-first task editor

systemArchitecture.narrative: Yjs handles document operations. Syncs states using WebSockets. Persists local state to browser IndexedDB store.
systemArchitecture.dataFlow: Offline edits -> Yjs CRDT update -> IndexedDB write -> Network re-establish -> WebSocket sync -> Peer merge.

resumeBullets: Developed CRDT editor sync engine utilizing WebSockets and Yjs for offline state reconciliation.
